summary: Small tree-shaded gravel car park by Girl Guides hall; signs mention loading zones.

best_section.where: West side of the small gravel car park, beside the Girl Guides hall

drivers.seclusion: Trees and park around the west side; nearest mapped home 40 m or more away, but one house sits 5 m from the north-east corner.
drivers.access_and_room: Gravel car park opens straight off the road bend; room for a van, with one car seen at the south end.
drivers.traffic: Beside a roundabout and a school loading zone; busy at drop-off and pick-up times.
drivers.convention: No campers seen; cyan signs show loading zones, no parking and no stopping nearby.

flags: Steep: about 3% falling to the south-west
Loading zone and no-parking signs near the car park mouth
School and Girl Guides use may bring people early or late
sun_shade: Heavy tree shade over most of the car park, open sky to the south.
cannot_judge: Whether the signs apply inside the car park
Night-time use by the school or guides
